About the job

We’re Hiring: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer!

We’re looking for a talented Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer to join our team and help build impactful, data-driven marketing solutions.

📌 Position: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer
💼 Experience: 2+ years
📍 Location: [Location / Remote]
🕐 Employment: Full-time

🔹 Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain solutions using Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Work with Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and Contact Builder
Build responsive and personalized email campaigns
Develop AMPscript, SQL queries, and SSJS solutions
Create and manage data extensions, automations, and customer journeys
Integrate SFMC with Salesforce CRM and other platforms
Troubleshoot and optimize marketing automation workflows
🔹 Requirements
2+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Strong knowledge of AMPscript, SQL, HTML/CSS
Experience with Journey Builder and Automation Studio
Understanding of data extensions, segmentation, and personalization
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are a plus
Strong problem-solving and communication skills

📩 Interested candidates: Send your CV to [Email Address]
Please mention “SFMC Developer” in the subject line.
